hero.subtitle: Photographer / Ternopil
hero.description: I don't just capture pretty pictures, but moments you will want to relive again.

list.title: Individual
list.description: Only you, your emotions, and the moment. An individual photoshoot is an expression of self-love, revealing your uniqueness, and capturing your true mood in aesthetic frames.

list.title: Couple / Wedding
list.description: About your love, touches, and real feelings. Preserving your unique story with no fake poses, just the two of you and the moment.

list.title: Family
list.description: Warm hugs, genuine laughter, and the real moments of your family. Preserving the best memories of how happy you are together in lively and warm frames.

footer.subtitle: Photographer
footer.description: Preserving your most precious moments in aesthetic and emotional frames. Available for shoots across Ukraine and Europe.

list.name: Olena and Maksym
list.text: It was an incredible experience! The photos exceeded all our expectations. Every shot looks like a magazine cover, yet is so alive and sincere. Thank you for preserving these memories for a lifetime.

list.name: Anna
list.text: I never liked myself in photos, but after this shoot, my self-esteem skyrocketed. A very comfortable atmosphere, absolutely no tension, and the result just blew up my social media!

list.name: The Kovalchuk Family
list.text: Catching our restless child in the frame seemed impossible, but you worked some magic. Very warm, cinematic photos. True art that we will hang on the walls of our home.
